evidence: LA6 bundles three claims; two are KA13/KB4 verbatim and the third (early-ack worker loss) does not survive the same refutation. (1) Early ack: posthog/celery.py:84 loads Celery config from Django settings (namespace CELERY) and no CELERY_TASK_ACKS_LATE exists under posthog/settings/, so early ack is the repo-wide default; acks_late/reject_on_worker_lost is opted into per task only for the ClickHouse query task (posthog/tasks/tasks.py:346-358). The pre-existing stamphog webhook task process_pull_request_event carries the identical decorator @shared_task(ignore_result=True, max_retries=3, default_retry_delay=5) (products/stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:809 vs 1109) with the same worker-loss exposure, and its GitHub delivery is already ACKed before the task runs (tasks.py:822-824), so the PR copies its sibling's pattern rather than introducing a defect. (2) A message lost before the ReviewRun row exists is recovered exactly as KA13 established for a lost publish: the receiver re-fires on every later TaskRun output save carrying the PR URL (products/review_hog/backend/receivers.py:75-79, 124-136; the task docstring states this contract at tasks.py:1124-1128), and such saves recur through set_task_run_output (products/tasks/backend/facade/api.py:2139-2154, reached from the set_output action at products/tasks/backend/presentation/views/api.py:1101-1118), the PATCH merge path (facade/api.py:2028-2043), and the webhook backstop _record_run_output_field (products/tasks/backend/webhooks.py:276-292). The refire dedupes on the PR's current head and restarts a still-QUEUED run (tasks.py:1195-1215), covered by test_inbox_receiver_leg_refires_dedupe_on_the_current_head (products/stamphog/backend/tests/test_tasks.py:992-1021, cases failed_run_recreated_on_refire and missed_webhook_head_gets_reviewed). Independently, later synchronize/reopen/retarget deliveries re-review through the webhook carve-out, which recomputes provenance from the tasks facade and never needs a prior ReviewRun (tasks.py:142-160, 868-880). (3) The 3x5s retry window, the stranded-QUEUED-without-reconciler state, and the mark-FAILED ask are the items KB4 already dismissed: _start_review_workflow propagates Temporal failures into the Celery retry (tasks.py:366-380, 1232-1237), the retry re-enters the dedupe and restarts the QUEUED run, and the webhook path has the same window with no reconciler either (tasks.py:383-409). Worker loss additionally requires a hard kill (SIGKILL/OOM) inside a task whose body is one config query, one PR fetch, and one short transaction; Celery's warm shutdown on deploy drains in-flight tasks, so the residual exposure is the same as every early-ack .delay() in the repo. acks_late + reject_on_worker_lost, backoff tuning, and a stale-QUEUED sweeper are hardening asks, not a reachable correctness defect in this tree.
notes: I would change my mind if the receiver stopped re-firing on later output saves (e.g. update_fields filtering dropped 'output'), if the webhook carve-out required a prior inbox-provenance ReviewRun before re-reviewing, or if production data showed inbox TaskRuns typically receive no output save after the one that records pr_url.
